title: Napoleon — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Napoleon.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Grilling Perfected." Napoleon started in Barrie, Ontario in 1976 making wood stoves. They evolved into one of North Americas leading outdoor grill manufacturers. Their Prestige PRO series features infrared rear and sizzle zone burners for steakhouse-quality searing. Strong Canadian brand with US distribution. Also makes fireplaces and HVAC.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Outdoor kitchen builders, BBQ enthusiasts, Canadian-made loyalists. Customers stepping up from Weber.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Napoleon:

• Canadian-made quality since 1976 — Barrie, Ontario manufacturing

• Infrared sizzle zone burner sears like a steakhouse

• Prestige PRO series rivals Lynx and Hestan at lower price points

• Full outdoor kitchen ecosystem — grills, burners, refrigeration

• Strong warranty and parts availability across North America
